security_justification.audit_integrity: The harness generates only synthetic fixture events through already-audited producer and collector code; it introduces no new audit-event path and asserts no new audit-integrity property.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: The harness exercises the collector's existing SyntheticFixtureAuthenticator with valid and deliberately invalid fixture credentials; it adds no new authentication mechanism or path.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No new authority or trust claim is introduced; the harness only observes outcomes already produced by authorized, merged code.
security_justification.concurrency: The harness runs each arm sequentially and awaits every promise; it introduces no new concurrency primitive beyond what the existing backpressure and shutdown components already provide.
security_justification.confidentiality: Only synthetic, non-production fixture data is used throughout; the evidence document contains no secret or credential material.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, key, or secret handling is introduced.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The evidence document records bounded result classes and codes already defined by the delivery-conformance-contract and each package's own diagnostics; no new error surface is created.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The fake network peer is entirely in-process; no external service, transport, or security integration is introduced.
security_justification.fail_posture: The harness verifies, without altering, the existing fail-closed posture of validation-before-admission and conflict-detection; a fail-posture regression discovered here is recorded as a finding, not fixed.
security_justification.lifecycle: The harness's own process lifecycle is a single run-to-completion script with no persistent state, timer, or background process beyond the deterministic fakes it constructs.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: All new files live under this change's own directory; no path under packages/ or contracts/ is modified.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal data is introduced; all fixtures are synthetic, matching the collector's own non-production scope.
security_justification.resource_retention: The harness holds no data beyond the lifetime of its own run; it creates no durable or long-lived resource.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The harness exercises, without changing, the existing bounded retry and deduplication behavior; the duplicate arm specifically verifies #391's fix without modifying it.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The harness operates entirely within the already-authorized collector/producer boundary (#107/#108); it adds no new trust boundary and authorizes no new capability.
